children.value: sarvatra sarvasargaśrīḥ sadaivāsti na ceti ca

prāsaṅgike jīvanmuktāhaṃkārasyābādhakatve samarthite prakrāntasya sarvatra sarvathā
sarvamityādyarthasya pāṣāṇākhyāyikayā samarthanaṃ yatpratijñātaṃ tadeva praṣṭuṃ
bhūmikāṃ racayati - aho iti

sarvaṃ sarvatra sarvathā sat sarvaṃ sarvatra sarvadā ca sat iti yatprastutaṃ tadanubhūtito
vimṛśyamānaṃ samamaviṣamamekarasameva paryavasyati

sarvadharmadharmiṇāṃ
deśataḥ kālato vastutaśca sarvabhāve vyāvṛttivyāvartakatādyasiddheriti bhāvaḥ

na pāṣāṇasāmyaṃ sarvadharmasaṃkaraṃ vā vaktuṃ pāṣāṇākhyāyikārabhyate kiṃtu
pāṣāṇodarādhyāsādhiṣṭhāne brahmaṇi asaṃkīrṇatayaiva
sarvajagadadhyāsasaṃbhavasaṃbhāvanāyetyāha - nīrandhreti
ayaṃ nyāyaḥ sarvatra yojanīya ityāśayenāha - antariti

yadi kuḍyādisarvabhāvābhāvāvacchinnaciti sarvajagadadhyāsa ākhyāyikābhipretastarhi
śuddhe cidākāśe sarvajagadadhyāsa ityeva pakṣaḥ kuto na parigṛhyate
yenādhyastajagadbādhe śuddhameva pariśiṣyata ityāparamanukūlaṃ syāditi rāmaḥ
pṛcchati - kuḍyādāviti
satyameṣa eva pakṣo mukhyatayā me vivakṣitaḥ

śuddhacidākāśaḥ sahasā na paricetuṃ
śakya iti tadupāyatayā upahitacityapi pratyekaṃ sarvajagadadhyāso darśita
ityāśayenottaramāha - etaditi
evaṃ dṛśyamātrasyaiva brahmamātratve anutpattireva phalitetyāha - ādāveveti

sarjanātsargo bṛṃhaṇādbrahmeti sṛjibṛṃhikriyayoḥ parasparaṃ
bhedābhāvādādhārādheyabhāvasya durvacatvācca na kriyāpi svarūpādvyatiricyata iti
sargabrahmādiśabdāḥ pravṛttinimittadharmarūpasvārthaparivarjitāḥ santaḥ
kuṭhārādinā vidārye kāṣṭhe ye dāruṇo ravāḥ prasiddhāstadvadarthaparivarjitāḥ santo
lakṣaṇayā atyantamavācye dṛṣṭiḥ pratītiryebhyastathāvidhā bhāntītyarthaḥ

athavā
dīryata iti dāru tadeva vidāryamiti paryāyaprāyau yau ravau śabdau
tadvadbhinnārthaparivarjitā bhāntītyarthaḥ

vyavahāre tu brahmaikaṃ
sargā nānetyarthabhedasattvādbhinnārthāḥ kiṃ na syustatrāha - dvaitamiti

yatra
vyavahāre dvaitamaikyaṃ cāsti tatrāpi sargabrahmādiśabdārthā manāgapi na bhānti

ādye'jñasya tasya kathaṃ bhāntu
dvitīye kasyeva bhāntu ke kiṃsvabhāvā bhāntu na hyadvaite bhānādbhāsyavailakṣaṇyaṃn
suvacamiti bhāvaḥ

yatra
vastuni dvaitamaikyaṃ ca manāgapi nāsti tatretyanvayaḥ
ata eva tattvavido vyavahārakāle'pi tattathaivāste ityāha - śāntamiti
